Found it — the draftReply config has `stopSequences: ['\n']`, which truncates replies right after the first newline, like stopping after "Dear customer," before the greeting continues. That gives a misleadingly normal-looking "stop" finish reason, so the fix is just removing that stopSequences line. I'm double-checking other configs like `chat` don't have this setting and ruling out maxOutputTokens as a contributing cause.
